primary_technique.name: GAN-based Face Swap
primary_technique.description: Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) based face swapping technique

all_techniques.name: GAN-based Face Swap
all_techniques.description: Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) based face swapping technique
all_techniques.mathematical_basis: Uses generator-discriminator architecture. Generator learns mapping G: X→Y, discriminator D distinguishes real from fake. Training objective: min_G max_D V(D,G) = E[log D(x)] + E[log(1-D(G(z)))]. Common implementations: StyleGAN, StarGAN, FaceSwap-GAN.
typical_artifacts: Blur artifacts at face boundaries due to generator's learned blending
High-frequency artifacts in frequency domain analysis

all_techniques.name: First-Order Motion Model
all_techniques.description: First-order motion model for face reenactment
all_techniques.mathematical_basis: Uses keypoint detection and motion transfer. Keypoints: K = {k₁, k₂, ..., kₙ}. Motion: M = K_driver - K_source. Warping: W(x, M) applies motion to source. Generator: G(x_source, M) = W(x_source, M) + residual. Common implementations: FOMM, Face2Face.
typical_artifacts: Temporal inconsistencies from keypoint tracking errors
Eye region artifacts from motion transfer

all_techniques.name: Neural Texture Synthesis
all_techniques.description: Neural texture synthesis for face manipulation
all_techniques.mathematical_basis: Uses neural texture fields: T(x,y) = f_θ(x,y). Texture mapping: I = T(UV_map). Optimization: min_θ ||I_target - T(UV_target)||². Common implementations: NeuralTextures, PIFu.

all_techniques.name: Face2Face
all_techniques.description: Real-time face reenactment using expression transfer
all_techniques.mathematical_basis: Uses 3D face model and expression transfer. 3D model: M = (V, F) where V are vertices, F are faces. Expression: E = {e₁, e₂, ..., eₙ}. Transfer: M_target = M_source + ΔE. Rendering: I = R(M_target, P, L). Common implementations: Face2Face, FaceForensics.
typical_artifacts: Severe lip-sync mismatches from expression transfer
Eye region artifacts from 3D model fitting

all_techniques.name: DeepFaceLab
all_techniques.description: Autoencoder-based face swap with advanced training
all_techniques.mathematical_basis: Uses SAE (Stacked Autoencoder) architecture. Multiple encoders: E₁, E₂, ..., Eₙ. Progressive training with increasing resolution. Loss: L = L_recon + λ₁·L_perceptual + λ₂·L_adversarial. Common implementations: DeepFaceLab, FaceSwap.
